subject.title: [Feature] Pre-response enforcement hooks (hard gates) for mandatory tool-call / policy rules

question: What fail-closed response-delivery and validator contract should OpenClaw support before final answers or public actions can be emitted?
rationale: The remaining work changes security guarantees, plugin API shape, config semantics, and final delivery behavior across harnesses, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary without maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Design a versioned response-gate API
options.body: Define the core/plugin contract for tool-call ledgers, validators, fail-closed behavior, retries, fallbacks, and audit records before implementation.

options.title: Limit scope to outbound message policy
options.body: Treat this issue as broader than current priority and move only the pre-send message boundary into a narrower item such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56349.

options.title: Keep policy packs plugin-only for now
options.body: Defer the core response gate and document that current plugin hooks can filter or block adjacent surfaces but cannot guarantee pre-response enforcement.

recommendation.title: Design a versioned response-gate API
recommendation.body: Define the core/plugin contract for tool-call ledgers, validators, fail-closed behavior, retries, fallbacks, and audit records before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/security boundary decision, and this account has recent adjacent audit/policy history plus prior maintainer-facing review context on this item.
